# 大肥鱼 clean

**Big Fat Fish clean** — an unofficial, immersive panel for the local
Mole CLI inside the DeepSeek H

arness Web UI.
It covers the same ground as the CLI from one dark panel: system health,
cleanup prev

iews with explicit confirmation, disk analysis, app inventory,
maintenance, cleanup history, and a g
uided Mole CLI install.

> Unofficial and not affiliated with the Mole project. The display name is
> intentionally distinct

from Mole; Mole CLI is credited below. No Mole code or
> assets are bundled — the plugin runs the `m
ole` binary you install yourself.

## Requirements and guided install

- macOS and the Mole CLI. The panel looks for
`mole` in Homebrew, `/usr/local/bin`, `~/.local/bin`,

or `MOLE_BIN`.
- When the CLI is missing, the panel shows an install guide instead of failing:
- **O

ne-click install** with Homebrew: runs `brew install mole` as a
background job, streams Homebrew's o

wn output in the live progress line and
re-checks automatically. It never runs `sudo`.
- Fallbacks:

install in Terminal, copy `brew install mole`, or (without
Homebrew) copy Mole's official install sc

ript, then **Check again**.
- The plugin is macOS-only today (terminal hand-off uses `open` / Termin

, then **Check again**.
- The plugin is macOS-only today (terminal hand-off uses `open` / Terminal).
## Tabs
| Tab | What it runs | Safety |

| Status | `mole status --json`, refreshed every 3 s | read-only |
| Clean | `mole clean --dry-run`,

then an explicit confirm to run `mole clean` | preview before removal |
| Apps | `mole uninstall --

list` and `mole uninstall --dry-run <app>` | removal handed to Terminal |
| Optimize | `mole optimiz

e --dry-run`, then an explicit confirm to run `mole optimize` | preview before maintenance |
| Analy

ze | `mole analyze --json <path>` with a treemap and drill-down | read-only |
| Tools | `mole purge

/ installer / slim --dry-run` | removal handed to Terminal |
| History | `mole history --json --limi

--dry-run` | removal handed to Terminal |
| History | `mole history --json --limit 60` | read-only |
## Design

The panel is built to feel like a page of the Harness window rather than a
separate application: a H

arness-style page header with an underline tab row, the
same spacing and type rhythm as host pages,

fluid card grids that adapt to the
main column, and a full-bleed dark space background with user-sup

plied planet
illustrations. It does not copy Mole for Mac's window chrome or tab bar.

- Live progress: every long operation (previews, real clean/optimize, disk
analysis, Mole CLI instal

l) starts a background job. A single status line
shows the current group/item from Mole's own output

, counters, and a
continuously updating elapsed time; a log toggle expands the recent output.
- Scan
and analysis results are localized to Chinese: the CLI only prints English, so the panel maps Mole'
s own group names, task names, statuses and summaries to Chinese while leaving real file paths, app

names and process names untouched.
- Tab switching keeps the running state and completed results: th

e panel state
lives in a persistent store, so leaving a tab or the panel and coming back
does not re

set buttons or lose results.
- Artwork (Earth/Jupiter/Sun, mascot/line-art icons) was supplied by th

e plugin
owner and embedded in the client bundle; no Mole application assets are
redistributed.
## Safety model

- Reads run automatically; every destructive surface is previewed with `--dry-run`.
- `clean`, `opti

mize` and `purge --yes` only run after an explicit confirmation
dialog. The panel never runs `sudo`;

system-level cleanup is left to the
user's Terminal.
- App uninstall, installer removal, slim and w

hitelist editing open a generated
`.command` file in Terminal.app instead of pretending those steps

can be
automated.
- A job lock prevents overlapping destructive or same-kind scans.
- Mutating local

routes require same-origin requests plus the `x-dsh-mole`
header.
## Trademark, licensing and asset provenance

This is an **unofficial** integration, not a fork of Mole and not affiliated
with or endorsed by the

nofficial** integration, not a fork of Mole and not affiliated
with or endorsed by the Mole project.

- **Mole CLI** belongs to tw93/Mole and is
licensed under GPL-3.0. This package bundles no Mole code

, binary, skill,
logo or Mole-for-Mac assets. It executes the user's own installed `mole`
binary as

a separate process and reads its JSON/text output.
- **"Mole" name**: the Mole project states that i

ts name and logo are
trademarks and that GPL covers code, not the brand. This package uses the
name

only descriptively ("for the Mole CLI") and is not published as an
official Mole product.
- **Mole f

or Mac** (`mole.fit`) is a separate proprietary app with its own
reserved name and assets. No assets

from that app are included.
- **User-supplied artwork**: `assets/mascot*.png`, `assets/planet-*.png

` and
`icon.png` come from images provided by the plugin owner. Their rights are
not established by
this package; confirm the license before redistributing.
## License
MIT for this plugin's code. Mole CLI is GPL-3.0 and is not part of this package.
